idea-plugin.name: Emberkai Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Emberkai Icons brings the Symbols file and folder icon set to JetBrains IDEs, as a companion to the Emberkai theme.

Java and Kotlin declarations keep their native IntelliJ type icons and badges.

Gradle Kotlin build scripts and version catalogs use Gradle icons. Spring Boot configuration and Helm charts have context-aware icons.

Includes CI pipelines, Ansible, infrastructure as code, database migrations, OpenAPI contracts, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Flux, and Argo CD, developer-tool configuration, and test assets.

Symbols-style project folders retain source/test colors, resource and package markers, and blue module/source-set badges, including Kotlin Multiplatform.

Icons by Miguel Solorio, from vscode-symbols.
